feedback: Pre-race review of the sensor_size step from 0.012 to 0.016, with kp 3.0, kd 0.8, ki 0, base_speed 1.0, line_loss last_direction and the iteration 0 spacing unchanged. The best raced design is iteration 4 (kp 3.0, kd 0.8, ki 0) at 600.47, so this candidate is judged against that bar. The candidate is valid: all sensor positions are inside range, the weights are unchanged, and sensor_size 0.016 is one of the allowed options. It changes one variable from the best design, so the next race isolates sensing footprint. The evidence for trying it is that slalom progress has stayed flat near 0.22 to 0.28 across kp 3.0 to 3.5 (iterations 4 and 5) and kd 0.4 to 0.8, with max_error near 0.06, so gain has not been the slalom lever. The earlier widened-spacing test (iteration 1) changed spacing and kp together, so it does not rule out a footprint change. The main risk is that a larger footprint blurs the s-bend response, since s-bend finishes are 14 of 20 at iteration 4. Racing is more informative than another revision here, and the candidate is a reasonable test. Do not treat the expected slalom gain as measured. Once the race reports: if slalom progress rises above about 0.25 with the oval still at 20 of 20, keep sensor_size 0.016 and test a sensor spacing refinement. If s-bend finishes fall below 14 with the oval unchanged, return sensor_size to 0.012 and keep the iteration 4 design as the base. If slalom stays flat, bend geometry is the limit, so the next lever is base_speed or sensor spacing rather than gain.
requested_changes: If slalom progress rises above about 0.25 and the oval holds 20 of 20 with sensor_size 0.016, keep geometry.sensor_size at 0.016 and test a small sensor spacing change (for example x = -0.03 to +0.03 in place of the 0.02 steps) with kp 3.0 and kd 0.8.

If s-bend finishes drop below 14 of 20 while the oval stays at 20 of 20, return geometry.sensor_size to 0.012 and keep the iteration 4 design (kp 3.0, kd 0.8, ki 0, base_speed 1.0) as the base, because iteration 4 is the best raced design.

If slalom progress stays near 0.22 to 0.25 with max_error near 0.06 under sensor_size 0.016, the slalom is limited by bend geometry rather than sensing or gain, so test controller.base_speed at 0.8 to 0.9 (slower entry to bends) with the better sensor_size, since raising speed has not been tried on slalom.
